storageFollowUp.scope: Optional local-filesystem headroom on one explicit absolute path with a required positive timeout up to10s and optional byte/percentage available-space floors. Defaults perform no filesystem read. Linux statfs observes fragment/block units and unprivileged available blocks, not directory/file/database contents; only total and available bytes enter monitor output or operator mail. Floors trigger strictly below either selected threshold with overflow-safe integer percentage ceilings. This observes the monitor's mount namespace, not a remote health server or arbitrary container data mount.
storageFollowUp.bounds: At most one filesystem read can remain in flight per probe. Caller deadline/cancellation returns without waiting for an uninterruptible kernel read; subsequent polls report storage_unavailable rather than accumulating workers, and late results are discarded. Failed/unsupported/nil/zero/impossible/overflowing measurements are unavailable, not healthy zero. HTTP/database/identity/runtime failures retain precedence; cancellation is not an incident. HTTP latency remains separate from the storage timeout. Paths, mount IDs and raw kernel errors are never serialized.
